g.text: Door intent review: production placement on the declared sheet
Placement accepted. The one-piece door construction shown below still needs your design review.
Shaker door · front
500 × 700 × 19 mm sheet; 400 × 600 mm door
Orange band = 10 mm sheet margin / no-cut zone
White = unused working area; blue = finished door
Part edge 13.2 mm from left/bottom of sheet
Hinge-cup · front / see-through cups
500 × 700 × 19 mm sheet; 400 × 600 mm door
Orange band = 10 mm sheet margin / no-cut zone
White = unused working area; blue = finished door
Part edge 13.2 mm from left/bottom of sheet
Hinge-cup door · flipped back setup
500 × 700 × 19 mm sheet; 400 × 600 mm door
Orange band = 10 mm sheet margin / no-cut zone
White = unused working area; blue = finished door
Upper-left placement follows the whole-sheet flip
What this currently makes
One piece of 19 mm MDF, with a 50 mm-wide frame and a 300 × 500 mm center recessed 6 mm.
The center remains 13 mm thick. A 12.7 mm flat cutter leaves approximately R6.35 inside corners.
The outside profile cuts to 19.2 mm with four 3 mm-high tabs. This is a milled face, not an assembled frame-and-panel door.
Section through the center, shown from the front surface
6 mm removed from center
13 mm remains below center
19 mm remains at the frame
Hinge version: two Ø35 × 13 mm back cups, centers 22.5 mm from the left door edge and 100 mm from each end.
Back bores run first; flip the whole sheet about X, then machine the front recess and tabbed outline.
Actual NC verifies translation, depths, spans, tabs and full cutter clearance. Blank sizes and all non-XY program words are unchanged.
This is computational evidence. Door construction approval and physical hardware fit are not implied.
Measurements and source/NC hashes: placement-measurements.json beside each recipe. Orange margin must remain uncut.
